environment.description: AWS Lambda (Quarkus native image) behind API Gateway with Cognito authorizer. Lambda execution role has full DynamoDB access: dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:Query on the user table with Resource: arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/UserTable. No IAM condition keys are applied. API Gateway validates JWT token presence but the Lambda code itself performs no authorization check matching caller identity to requested resource.

config.api_gateway: Cognito authorizer validates token, passes claims in requestContext
